summary: Zeta Network Group filed a Form 6-K reporting a July 29, 2026 securities purchase agreement for a private placement of units, each comprising one Class A ordinary share and one warrant, at $2.93 per unit for aggregate gross proceeds of about $10.0 million. Payment is in approximately 156.65 Solv-BTC, a Bitcoin-backed token, at an exchange rate of $63,835.08 per token. Warrants are immediately exercisable at $4.40 per share and expire in five years. The offering resembles a rights-like capital raise to existing or selected investors, with customary closing conditions. Watch for potential dilution from warrant exercise and token price volatility affecting proceeds.
